verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only mentions a landing-page 'playground widget' that a user found buggy (solid-comm-3) and some example demos failing to load (solid-comm-6) — there is no evidence of a structured, in-browser interactive tutorial for learning SolidJS hands-on without local setup. Missing for 10: any first-party documentation of a step-by-step interactive tutorial, confirmation the playground supports guided lessons, and corroboration it works reliably across browsers.
